answer: Resisting sybils in agent economies resembles how a massive glacier slowly accumulates irreversible structural damage under continuous cyclic loading. Just as high density onyx inserts inhibit dislocation slip to arrest micro-void coalescence, cryptographic proof-of-work bonds impose a strict computational energy expenditure per node. To forge a single fraudulent identity, an adversary must continuously sink capital and power equivalent to the physical yield stress threshold of the verification lattice.
